text_blocks.snippet: To regain your sense of smell and taste after COVID-19, try olfactory training and give your body time to heal. Damage to nerve cells in the nose can affect smell, and support cells also play a role in recovery. Olfactory training, which involves smelling different scents and recalling associated memories, can help stimulate nerve cells.
